framework.name: National Business Education Standards
framework.source: https://www.nbea.org (National Standards for Business Education; wording is the school's own)

objectives.description: Explain how businesses meet needs and wants and why they exist.
Compare sole proprietorships, partnerships and corporations.
Describe the role of business in the economy, including jobs, taxes and innovation.
Explain scarcity, supply and demand as they apply to a small business.
Describe the traits and skills of successful entrepreneurs.
Identify a problem a customer has and propose a business idea to solve it.
Write a one-page business plan that includes a mission, customers and a budget.
Explain the four Ps of marketing: product, price, place and promotion.
Conduct a short survey of potential customers and summarize the results.
Design an advertisement and explain how it appeals to a target audience.
Describe the functions of management: planning, organizing, leading and controlling.
Explain business ethics and give examples of ethical and unethical choices.
Describe the rights and responsibilities of employees and employers.
Calculate revenue, costs and profit for a simple business.
Explain how businesses obtain funding, including loans and investors.
Present a business pitch to a panel and respond to questions.
Research a career in business and describe the education it requires.
